a.text: I'll keep our agreement and operate in round 1. I know storms are likely, but grabbing the reserve early would just leave one of us stranded. Let's operate together to 8, then take 4 each. I'll tell you honestly if anything changes.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
